R3_conclusion: Q-A: PINN rel L2 error over 5 seeds: best 7.71e-04, worst 1.71e-02. FV reaches the best PINN error with N=128 in 1.46e-03 s versus a median PINN training time of 448 s.
Q-B: surrogate max rel error over 9 points, J: 9.08e-02-6.96e-01, dJ/da: 1.75e-01-5.33e-01.
No break-even M found: FV at the matched accuracy is not slower per evaluation than PINN inference (or the ladder cannot match PINN accuracy).
Scope: one 1D problem, one fixed PINN configuration (no tuning), CPU only; the conclusion does not extend to other problems.
